title: GitHub
hint: Personal access token. Tạo ở github.com/settings/tokens, chỉ cấp quyền cần dùng.
hint_en: Personal access token. Create it at github.com/settings/tokens with only the scopes you need.
name: github_token
description: Token GitHub API. Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:github_token}} và Accept: application/vnd.github+json.
description_en: GitHub API token. Send the header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:github_token}} and Accept: application/vnd.github+json.

title: Gitea / Forgejo
hint: Access token ở Cài đặt → Ứng dụng. Sửa máy chủ thành tên miền Gitea của bạn.
hint_en: Access token from Settings → Applications. Change the host to your Gitea domain.
name: gitea_token
description: Token Gitea API. Gửi header Authorization: token {{secret:gitea_token}}. Đường dẫn bắt đầu bằng /api/v1.
description_en: Gitea API token. Send the header Authorization: token {{secret:gitea_token}}. Paths start with /api/v1.

title: Cloudflare
hint: API token ở dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens, giới hạn theo zone.
hint_en: API token from dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens, scoped to the zones you need.
name: cloudflare_token
description: Token Cloudflare API v4. Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:cloudflare_token}}. Đường dẫn bắt đầu bằng /client/v4.
description_en: Cloudflare API v4 token. Send the header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:cloudflare_token}}. Paths start with /client/v4.

title: OpenAI
name: openai_key
description: Khoá OpenAI API. Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:openai_key}}.
description_en: OpenAI API key. Send the header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:openai_key}}.

title: Anthropic
name: anthropic_key
description: Khoá Anthropic API. Gửi header x-api-key: {{secret:anthropic_key}} và anthropic-version: 2023-06-01.
description_en: Anthropic API key. Send the headers x-api-key: {{secret:anthropic_key}} and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01.

title: Google AI (Gemini)
name: google_ai_key
description: Khoá Gemini API. Gửi header x-goog-api-key: {{secret:google_ai_key}}.
description_en: Gemini API key. Send the header x-goog-api-key: {{secret:google_ai_key}}.

title: DeepSeek
name: deepseek_key
description: Khoá DeepSeek API, tương thích OpenAI. Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:deepseek_key}}.
description_en: DeepSeek API key, OpenAI compatible. Send the header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:deepseek_key}}.

title: Notion
hint: Internal integration secret ở notion.so/my-integrations. Nhớ chia sẻ trang cho integration.
hint_en: Internal integration secret from notion.so/my-integrations. Share the pages with the integration.
name: notion_token
description: Token Notion API. Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:notion_token}} và Notion-Version: 2022-06-28.
description_en: Notion API token. Send the headers Authorization: Bearer {{secret:notion_token}} and Notion-Version: 2022-06-28.

title: PostgreSQL
hint: Đăng nhập database. Nên dùng user chỉ có quyền SELECT. Cần image exec.
hint_en: Database login. Prefer a user that can only SELECT. Needs the exec image.
name: postgres
description: Đăng nhập PostgreSQL. Chạy /usr/bin/psql bằng run_command với env PGHOST={{secret:postgres.host}}, PGPORT={{secret:postgres.port}}, PGUSER={{secret:postgres.user}}, PGDATABASE={{secret:postgres.database}}, PGPASSWORD={{secret:postgres.password}}, rồi argv -X -c "câu truy vấn".
description_en: PostgreSQL login. Run /usr/bin/psql with run_command and env PGHOST={{secret:postgres.host}}, PGPORT={{secret:postgres.port}}, PGUSER={{secret:postgres.user}}, PGDATABASE={{secret:postgres.database}}, PGPASSWORD={{secret:postgres.password}}, then argv -X -c "query".

title: Khoá SSH
hint: Khoá riêng để SSH vào máy chủ. Nên tạo khoá riêng cho ucanrun. Cần image exec.
hint_en: A private key to SSH into a server. Create a key just for ucanrun. Needs the exec image.
name: ssh_key
description: Khoá SSH riêng. Chạy /usr/bin/ssh bằng run_command, đặt khoá vào files {"id_key": "{{secret:ssh_key}}"} và argv -i id_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=known_hosts user@host "lệnh".
description_en: SSH private key. Run /usr/bin/ssh with run_command, put the key in files {"id_key": "{{secret:ssh_key}}"} and argv -i id_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=known_hosts user@host "command".

title: Mật khẩu sudo
hint: Mật khẩu sudo của user trên máy chủ, dùng cùng khoá SSH. Mặc định luôn cần TOTP.
hint_en: The server user's sudo password, used with an SSH key. Always asks for TOTP by default.
name: sudo_password
description: Mật khẩu sudo. Đưa vào stdin {{secret:sudo_password}} và chạy lệnh từ xa dạng sudo -S -p '' /usr/bin/lệnh.
description_en: sudo password. Pass it as stdin {{secret:sudo_password}} and run the remote command as sudo -S -p '' /usr/bin/command.

title: API key khác
hint: Mọi API dùng token trong header. Ghi rõ header và máy chủ trong mô tả.
hint_en: Any API that takes a token in a header. Write the header and host in the notes.
description: Khoá API cho ... Gửi header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:TÊN}}.
description_en: API key for ... Send the header Authorization: Bearer {{secret:NAME}}.
